# Grey Heron

The grey heron stands still in shallow water and waits for fish.[^coastal-birds] It
hunts by [wading](/wiki/concepts/wading.md); see also
[Grey Heron and Little Egret](/wiki/comparisons/heron-vs-egret.md) and the
[bird guide](/sources/nature/coastal-birds/coastal-birds.md).

At low tide it wades into rock pools to hunt small fish.[^tide-pools]
